description: Fetch trulyrandomverse.com's own commentary on a verse, as the verse's page shows it. Where the verse belongs to a passage study (`kind` passage_study), one call returns all of it: what this verse says, its phrase-by-phrase notes, the study of the whole passage under its own headings, and the notes on the passage's other verses. `section` is not used there, and the same study answers for every verse of `passage`, so call once for a passage. A verse with a newer commentary of its own (`kind` verse_commentary) also comes whole. Every other verse has the older commentary, one `section` at a time: 'summary', 'context', 'exposition', 'theological', 'reflection', 'faq', 'christ_centered'. One of three peer commentary sources — pair with get_matthew_henry and get_church_fathers for a full picture. None is sufficient alone; do not treat this as 'the' source.
name: get_commentary_section
title: TrulyRandomVerse commentary
